description: Ask someone to sign a document on a hosted page, and get the signing link to give them. kind contract: text is the agreement exactly as the shop wrote it (Doing Work never writes contract or legal wording). kind job_document: a stored job PDF (documents.list). The signer signs in, reads it, types their name and agrees to sign electronically. Agents can never sign.

document_id.description: kind job_document: the stored PDF to sign.

signer_email.description: Only this signed-in email may sign. Leave out to let whoever opens the link and signs in sign.

signer_role.description: customer (default): someone outside the shop; a shop member cannot sign it for them. member: a worker in the shop signs.

text.description: kind contract: the full text to sign, written by the shop.

title.description: What the signer sees as the heading, for example Service agreement.

name: signatures_request
